children: Saudi Arabia's economy contracts in the second quarter as a sharp decline in oil activity outweighs modest growth elsewhere, according to the General Authority for Statistics. Real gross domestic product falls 4.7% on year, with oil activities down 24.8%, while non-oil and government activities each grow 0.9%. The breakdown shows the downturn remains concentrated in the oil sector, with underlying non-oil activity continuing to expand despite regional disruption. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)
